opportunities.name: Gloom attack reach
opportunities.objective: Test a charged extended attack as the safe consumer of E-applied Gloom.
opportunities.mechanic: E applies Gloom; an attack consumes it for 0.25 AP magic damage and reduces Doom cooldown by 25%. RFC extends one energized attack, while Lich Bane supplies a separate attack packet after E. Nashor asks whether continued attacks are productive; W shield gives an escape buffer and Q provides an alternative Gloom consumer.
opportunities.requiredState: E connects, RFC is charged and one attack occurs before Q/W consumes the same Gloom.
opportunities.failure: Crit/attack speed spending weakens spells and pursuit can expose Vex after the charged hit.
opportunities.test: Log attack range, Gloom damage and Doom timer after one E-attack versus E-Q.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Repeated on-hits or three Hail attacks do not consume one Gloom mark three times.

opportunities.name: Fear-fed dive recovery
opportunities.objective: Turn first-contact fear into an ally vulnerability window before seeking an R reset.
opportunities.mechanic: Doom empowers the next basic spell with fear; R itself is a marked dive with a conditional takedown reset. Mandate marks on the basic-spell fear, while Cryptbloom can heal around a damaged target death and Cosmic grants speed on magic contact. W AP shield and Zhonya protect the first arrival as the team finishes the mark.
opportunities.requiredState: Doom ready; R mark hits, arrive with W fear and allies can follow within the mark window.
opportunities.failure: No first takedown means neither reset nor death heal; defensive slots can lose the burst race.
opportunities.test: Time R arrival, W fear/Mandate, allied finish and Cryptbloom heal with Doom ready versus unavailable.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: R takedown reset requires its own mark window; any unrelated later kill is insufficient.

ruledOut.reason: Passive documents timed recharge and 25% reduction on Gloom consumption; basic haste does not establish direct passive recharge scaling.

unknowns: R damage and takedown-window tooltips remain cross-referenced. RFC delivery, Gloom timer and Mandate interaction require live checks.

RFC extends one energized attack, while Lich Bane supplies a separate attack packet after E. Nashor asks whether continued attacks are productive; W shield gives an escape buffer and Q provides an alternative Gloom consumer.
testPlan: Required state: E connects, RFC is charged and one attack occurs before Q/W consumes the same Gloom.
Log attack range, Gloom damage and Doom timer after one E-attack versus E-Q.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Crit/attack speed spending weakens spells and pursuit can expose Vex after the charged hit.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Repeated on-hits or three Hail attacks do not consume one Gloom mark three times.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Rapid Firecannon, Lich Bane, Nashor's Tooth, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Every [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=25, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -3.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds Vex becomes afflicted with Doom, causing her next basic Ability to Knock Down and Fear enemies for [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.75, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.25, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 9, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.25, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.25, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] seconds.

Vex gains [50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (0.75) × AP] Shield for [2.5] seconds and emits a shockwave that deals [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (0.3) × AP] magic damage.

Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.

Vex commands Shadow to fly to a location, increasing in size as it travels. Upon arriving, it deals [50 / 70 / 90 / 110 / 130 + (0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5 / 0.55 / 0.6) × AP] magic damage and Slows by [(0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5) × 100]% for [2] seconds.

Killing an enemy with this ability reduces Doom'n Gloom's Cooldown by [10]%.

Applies Gloom to enemies hit.

Vex launches a wave of mist that deals [70 / 115 / 160 / 205 / 250 + (0.7) × AP] magic damage. After a delay, the wave becomes smaller and faster.

Consumes Gloom on enemies hit.
